probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Nordhavn Overview Buy Ella Mae Pilot Crew Ferry Models Pilot Crew Ferry Company About Team Investors Careers Media News Events Owners Service Charging Customer stories Contact Rotterdam pilots take delivery of the first four Pilot boats Four P15s left the Waalhaven yard this week for their final fit-out at the pilot station, ahead of service from November. Published 4 September 2026 Category Deliveries Press contact [email protected] LinkedIn Copy link Four P15s left the Waalhaven yard this week on their own power, heading across the river to the Rotterdam pilot station for their final fit-out. The station will add its radios, its own livery and the flag mast before the boats start training runs in October. Service begins in November, once the flag approval is in place. A first for the port These are the first electric pilot boats to work the port of Rotterdam. Together they replace four diesel launches and save an estimated 1,100 tonnes of CO2 a year, with quieter shifts for the crews and the people living along the river.
